docs.desc: PRESS RELEASE DATED NOVEMBER 10, 2026, TITLED "ETORO REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026

desk.headline: Net contribution down 13% to $186m, in line; adjusted EPS $0.26 below estimate as crypto trading slumps; $250m buyback, no outlook

other.label: Revenue basis
other.change: total revenue and income less crypto cost of revenue and margin interest; gross total $1.49bn

results: Net contribution, eToro's main revenue measure, fell 13% to $186m as crypto trading cooled sharply; gross crypto revenue dropped to $1.35bn from $3.97bn.
Trading income from shares, commodities and currencies rose to $88.5m from $72.9m, but net interest income from users slipped to $50.0m from $58.9m.
Net income fell 74% to $15.0m ($0.14 a diluted share) and adjusted EBITDA fell 56% to $34.2m, with marketing spend up 42% to $68.1m.
Funded accounts grew 18% to 4.39m, while assets under administration were flat at $20.8bn.
The board approved a new buyback of up to $250m, and eToro agreed to buy Argentine investing and payments app LB Finanzas.

guidance.summary: eToro gives no financial guidance. Its October update showed AUA down 6% y/y to $19.2bn, crypto trades down 62% and capital-markets trades down 22%.

watch: Whether crypto activity recovers after the weak October numbers.
Pace of buybacks under the new $250m programme.
Marketing costs versus funded-account growth, and the closing of LB Finanzas.

sources.title: eToro Q3 2026: Crypto Slowdown Hits Profit Despite User Growth — 24/7 Wall St., 10 Nov 2026
